scene.ko: 일주일째 이어지는 기침이 밤에 더 심하다고 자세히 설명하고, 약을 먹어야 하는지와 다시 와야 하는지 묻는다.

lines.en: So, what seems to be the problem?
I've had a bad cough for about a week, and it gets worse at night.
lines.ko: 일주일쯤 기침이 심하게 나는데, 밤에 더 심해져요.
alt: I've been coughing a lot for about a week. It's worse at night.
I've had a cough for a week, and it's worse at night.

lines.en: Do you have a fever or any other symptoms?
No fever, but my chest feels tight sometimes.
alt: I don't have a fever, but sometimes my chest feels tight.
No fever. My chest feels a little tight sometimes, though.

lines.en: Let me listen to your chest. Take a deep breath... Okay, your lungs sound clear. It's probably just a cough left over from a cold.
lines.ko: 가슴 소리를 들어 볼게요. 숨을 크게 쉬어 보세요... 네, 폐 소리는 깨끗해요. 아마 감기 끝에 남은 기침일 거예요.

lines.en: That's a relief. Do I need to take any medicine?
alt: Good to hear. Should I take any medicine?
Oh, good. Will I need some medicine?

lines.en: You can take some cough syrup at night. Also, drink plenty of water and get some rest.
lines.ko: 밤에 기침 시럽을 드시면 돼요. 그리고 물을 많이 마시고 푹 쉬세요.

lines.en: Okay. Should I come back if it doesn't get better?
lines.ko: 알겠어요. 나아지지 않으면 다시 와야 하나요?
alt: Got it. What if it doesn't get better?
Okay. Do I need to come back if it doesn't go away?

lines.en: Yes. If it's not better in a week, or if you get a fever, come back and see me.
lines.ko: 네. 일주일 안에 나아지지 않거나 열이 나면 다시 오세요.

expressions.en: I've had ___ for about a week.
expressions.note: 증상이 이어진 기간 · have had + 기간
